you_should_know.summary: Colorado's lawsuit alleging that the Trump administration retaliated against the state over its election policies and its prosecution of former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters moved forward on new evidence. Colorado's side called the email a "smoking gun"; the White House denied any connection to the Peters prosecution.
